F.M. 2

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
S.1, Special Branch Station.
REPORT
Date June 8, 1937.
Subject Hugh GILMER - communication from British Consulate-General.
Made by D.S. Henchman Forwarded by J. Byrne S.I.

With reference to the attached communication, I have
to state that Hugh Gilmer, British subject, aged 38, arrived
in Shanghai from Japan aboard the s.s. "FUSHIMA MARU" on May
17, 1937. Accompanied by a Japanese he is believed to have
visited the Orient Hotel (Sinceres), Nanking Road, where he
remained for a few hours and then left having stated his
intention of leaving Shanghai immediately. His destination
and the identity of the Japanese who accompanied him are
unknown.

On his alien declaration papers, Gilmer stated that
he was visiting Shanghai as a tourist and that he would
remain in China for two or three weeks. His passport number
was given as British A.161913 issued in Sydney, N.S.W. on
June 5, 1935, and visaed in Melbourne, Vic., on September 19,
1935.

There is no record of Gilmer in Police files.

D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch)

档案编号
S.1，特别分站。
报告
日期：1937年6月8日。
事由：休·吉尔默（Hugh GILMER）——来自英国总领事馆的来函。
呈报人：D.S. Henchman 转交人：J. Byrne 警佐

关于所附来函，本人谨陈述如下：英国籍人士休·吉尔默（Hugh Gilmer），现年38岁，于1937年5月17日乘坐“福岛丸”号（s.s. "FUSHIMA MARU"）轮船从日本抵达上海。据信，他由一名日本人陪同，曾前往南京路的新新公司东方饭店（Orient Hotel (Sinceres)），停留数小时后离开，并称其打算立即离开上海。其目的地及陪同他的那名日本人的身份均不详。

在其外侨申报单上，吉尔默称其以游客身份访问上海，并将在中国停留两至三周。其护照号码为英国A.161913号，1935年6月5日签发于新南威尔士州悉尼，1935年9月19日在维多利亚州墨尔本加签签证。

警务处档案中无吉尔默的记录。

D. S.

D. C.（特别分部）

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O.BOX 259.    SHANGHAI.

31st May 1937.

My dear Bourne,

I shall be grateful if you will inform me
whether you have any record of one HUGH GILMER, British
subject born at Nelson, New Zealand and holder of British
Passport No. A.161913 issued at Melbourne on 5th June 1935.
He was a passenger to Hongkong in the
"Chichibu Maru" and states he is a retired theatrical man.
Gilmer's photograph is attached hereto and when finished
with I request its return.

Yours Sincerely,

（批：To record
in 3/18 reg
LBS）

S1
（印：31 MAY 1937）

Major K.M. Bourne M.C.,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Foochow Road,
Shanghai.

（手写：DS Henckman 11/3）

英国总领事馆，
邮政信箱259号。 上海。

1937年5月31日。

亲爱的伯恩：

如蒙告知贵处是否有关于休·吉尔默（HUGH GILMER）的记录，本人将不胜感激。此人为英国籍，出生于新西兰纳尔逊（Nelson），持有1935年6月5日于墨尔本签发的英国护照第A.161913号。
他曾作为乘客乘坐“秩父丸”号（"Chichibu Maru"）前往香港，并称自己是一名退休的戏剧界人士。
随函附上吉尔默的照片一张，使用完毕后，请予归还。

此致

敬礼

（批注：存入 3/18 登记册
LBS）

S1
（印章：1937年5月31日）

K.M. Bourne 少校，军功十字勋章获得者，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
福州路，
上海。

（手写：DS Henckman 11/3）
